rules.statement: A co-owner cannot establish a prescriptive title against another co-owner unless there is evidence of an ouster or something equivalent to an ouster, and the possession must be exclusive for more than ten years before the institution of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "His possession was in law the possession of his co-owners. It was not possible for him to put an end to that possession by any secret intention in his mind. Nothing short of ouster or something equivalent to ouster could bring about that result."
